meta.description: Analyze Perturb-seq / CROP-seq single-cell CRISPR screens, including guide assignment, escaper removal, calibrated testing, effect size, composition, and baseline-aware prediction evaluation.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md
meta.executed_inputs: 5/7 code paths; two text-only boundaries were freshly inspected with saved verifier scripts

scientific_integrity.detail: Only values produced in saved local runs are reported, and simulated data is labeled.

practice_boundaries.detail: The skill analyzes research data and makes no individual diagnosis or treatment recommendation.

methodological_ground.detail: It requires controls, biological replication, SCEPTRE calibration before discovery, and perturbation-level holdout.

code_usability.detail: The pinned private-library SCEPTRE example freshly completed. Missing optax is explicitly documented and has a working fallback, so it is a P1 verification gap rather than unexplained unrunnable code.

functional_suitability.note: All advertised workflows are covered; the optional JAX primary path remains unverified here.

reliability.note: Realistic fallbacks and the private SCEPTRE route are clear; the JAX primary needs an isolated environment.

performance_context.note: The tested Mixscape memory safeguard is concrete, although full real-data workflows are resource-intensive.

agent_usability.note: Decision tables, prerequisites, and error remedies are clear but substantial setup remains.

human_usability.note: Natural research triggers are well covered; data preparation remains specialist work.

security.note: No credentials, raw command interpolation, or destructive handling was found.

maintainability.note: The pinned standalone SCEPTRE example is testable; key Python regressions still need a large external dataset.

agent_specific.note: Trigger precision and escape hatches are strong; the broad workflow has limited progressive disclosure and a side-environment dependency.

key_strengths: The current Mixscape block completed on real data with its documented memory safeguard.
The new source-faithful pinned private-library SCEPTRE example freshly proved calibration before discovery.
The workflow uses a valid replicate-target Milo design and separates composition from within-state expression.
The prediction guard prevents cell-split leakage and trivial-baseline overclaims.

recommendations.title: Verify the primary optax mixture backend
recommendations.problem: The default assign_mixture_model route was not executable in the shared environment because optax is absent; only its documented fallback ran.
recommendations.root_cause: The JAX extra is intentionally absent from the shared environment.
recommendations.fix: Create a compatible isolated pertpy[jax] environment without changing the shared one, then rerun primary mixture assignment on the same fixture.

recommendations.title: Add small deterministic regression fixtures
recommendations.problem: Core Python regressions require a cached large Papalexi dataset.
recommendations.root_cause: No compact fixture exercises metadata, Mixscape, and Milo contracts.
recommendations.fix: Add a small synthetic fixture with expected invariants.

recommendations.title: Document Windows worker cleanup warning
recommendations.problem: Milo produced all promised outputs but a loky worker emitted WinError 6 during cleanup.
recommendations.root_cause: Parallel cleanup is fragile on this Windows runtime.
recommendations.fix: Document and verify a serial or controlled-worker option if reproducible.
